_meta.description: Policy table that defines which actions the agent may handle directly versus those requiring escalation. The escalation tool MUST consult this table before acting.

password_reset_guidance.description: Walk the user through self-service password reset (forgot-password flow).
password_reset_guidance.rationale: Self-service flow exists at sso.acme.com/reset; no privileged action by agent.

mfa_reset.description: Reset a user's multi-factor authentication device or backup codes.
mfa_reset.rationale: MFA bypass is a critical attack vector; requires verified identity check by IAM staff per security policy SEC-IAM-003.

account_unlock.description: Unlock a user account that was locked by Okta or another SSO provider.
account_unlock.rationale: Account lockouts may indicate either a forgotten credential or an active credential-stuffing attack. IAM must review the lockout reason before unlocking.

vpn_troubleshooting_guidance.description: Walk the user through standard VPN connectivity troubleshooting (client restart, MTU, DNS, route).

saas_outage_communication.description: Inform the user of a known SaaS service degradation and provide the documented workaround.
saas_outage_communication.rationale: Communicating known status is information sharing, not action.

snowflake_prod_access.description: Grant a user read or write access to a production Snowflake database.
snowflake_prod_access.rationale: Production data access falls under data governance policy DG-001. Both line manager and dataset data-owner approvals are mandatory.

snowflake_dev_access.description: Grant a user access to a development Snowflake database.
snowflake_dev_access.rationale: Dev access is lower-risk but still requires manager sign-off for cost-allocation tracking.

grafana_readonly_access.description: Grant read-only access to internal Grafana dashboards.
grafana_readonly_access.rationale: Read-only observability access is provisioned automatically via Okta group `grafana-readers`. Agent may instruct the user how to request via the standard self-service form.

production_incident_investigation.description: Investigate a multi-system production failure such as a data pipeline outage spanning multiple services.
production_incident_investigation.rationale: Multi-system incidents may require log inspection, infrastructure changes, and cross-team coordination beyond the agent's read-only mock data tools.

new_hardware_request.description: Request a new laptop, monitor, dock, or other hardware.
new_hardware_request.rationale: Hardware requests have budget implications; require manager sign-off.

software_license_request.description: Request a paid software license (Adobe, Figma seat, JetBrains, etc.).
software_license_request.rationale: License purchases require manager sign-off and procurement processing.

general_troubleshooting.description: Generic IT troubleshooting guidance for issues with no privileged action required.
general_troubleshooting.rationale: Default action when no privileged operation is needed.
